caption:
What you actually keep on your salary in 2026–27.

$75,000 → $60,480 (about $1,163 a week)
$100,000 → $77,480 (about $1,490 a week)
$125,000 → $94,480 (about $1,817 a week)
$150,000 → $110,430 (about $2,124 a week)
$200,000 → $140,130 (about $2,695 a week)

That's income tax at 2026–27 resident rates plus the 2% Medicare levy, on salary before super. It leaves out HELP repayments, tax offsets and the Medicare levy surcharge (which can apply over $105,000 for singles without private hospital cover), so your own number will differ.

The gap between the two columns is what deductions, super and offsets work on.

Which line is closest to you?
